units: <cite ref="Chullin 111a">Ḥull. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>מִשְׁרַג שָׁרֵיג</he> Ar. a. Ms. R. 2 (ed. <he>משרק שריק</he>), v. <cite ref="U02022"><he>שְׁרַק</he> II</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 93a:20">B. Mets. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>שריג חד וכ׳</he> (Ms. H. <he>שוור</he>, v. <cite ref="U01923">preced.</cite>) one of the animals slipped and fell &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 130">Yalk. Gen. 130</cite> <he>שְׁרוֹג</he>.
<cite ref="Nazir 39a:7">Naz. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>שָׁרוּגֵי שְׁרִיגָא ואזלא</he> (not <he>ואזיל</he>; Rashi <he>שרוגי קא מִשְׁתָּרְגָא</he>) it may have slid further and further (to the top of the hair).
